scenario: [RARC.5.2.7] with [LNUL.3.1]: a rule's `emit` of `null` into a slot not declared `T?` raises a TypeError naming the slot, and the fact does not enter. `p.body.name` is a Json path the document does not have, so it reads `null` at runtime; `Out.v` is a non-nullable Int. `handler` pins that the fault fact names `Out.v` and the tag `Null`. Path: libds rete/engine.c eval_actions (ds_rete_slot_refused's null arm), Mercury ds.exec.m assert_verb (`sr_null_non_nullable`).
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

schema Out scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Payload p
->
    emit Out logical v: p.body.name

rule handler:
    TypeError e where e.schema == "Out" and e.slot == "v"
->
    log info "refused Out.v {e.actual}"
